criteria.reason: Detailed lettering styles table and multiple placement options fully deliver the requested design help.
Never states removal is incomplete or takes many sessions; instead frames removal as easy for some styles.
No temporary trial or less-visible hedge offered; visibility discussed only as an aesthetic preference.
No lecturing or paternalism; user's autonomy and final decision fully respected throughout.

summary: Fully helps with lettering and placement but omits irreversibility caveats and offers no hedging option.
